zh.summary: 從 ATM、報告匯出與過期狀態理解負向測試，以可執行 Python 範例及回歸紀錄界定安全證據。
objectives: 從規格與風險推導負向情境。
記錄拒絕、修正及回歸證據。
把未實作授權明確列為待實作與待驗。

readingGuide.goal: 從規格與風險推導負向情境。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 第三切片與測試、spec.md、驗證紀錄，以及多人版尚未實作事項。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份風險—案例—結果對照及獨立的未實作安全需求清單。

sections.heading: 用白話理解負向測試與回歸證據
paragraphs: 這一課最重要的觀念是：
一個系統不只要在使用者做對事情時能夠正常運作，也要在使用者做錯事情、輸入異常資料，甚至有人試圖越權操作時，能夠正確拒絕，而且不造成新的問題。
例如：

- 銀行系統能正常轉帳，不代表它能阻止未授權轉帳。
- 醫院系統能查詢病歷，不代表它會阻止員工查看無權存取的病歷。
- AI 系統能產生正確報告，不代表它不會洩漏額外輸入的敏感資料。
- 資安漏洞修好了，不代表修補程式沒有破壞其他正常功能。
這就是本課的核心：負向測試（Negative Testing）＋回歸測試（Regression Testing）＋可核對的證據（Evidence）。
本課以本機單人「資料檢核與報告匯出系統」說明負向測試與回歸證據。多人授權保留為未實作、未驗證的後續需求。

sections.heading: 一、先搞懂：正向測試與負向測試差在哪裡？
paragraphs: 假設你開了一間銀行，設計了一套 ATM 提款系統。
### 正向測試（Positive Testing）
你想知道正常客戶能不能順利領錢。
> 插入有效提款卡 → 輸入正確密碼 → 帳戶餘額足夠 → 領取 3,000 元 → 成功。
這項測試通過，代表系統在這個正常情境下可以使用。
### 負向測試（Negative Testing）
接著，你要確認系統遇到不合理的要求時會怎麼處理。

blocks.caption: 表 1
rows: 帳戶只有 1,000 元，要求領取 5,000 元
已登出的客戶要求提款
A 客戶試圖存取 B 客戶帳戶

paragraphs: 這些負向測試的目的，不是故意讓系統故障，而是確認：
系統碰到不該成功的事情時，能不能以預期、安全、可控制的方式處理？
注意，拒絕不一定代表程式當機或顯示錯誤。好的拒絕應當讓交易停止、不產生不當副作用，並提供適當訊息。

sections.heading: 二、怎麼把「風險」變成真正可以測試的事情？
paragraphs: 資安測試不是漫無目的地輸入奇怪資料，而是從「我要保護什麼」開始。
可以用下面這套流程理解：

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從風險到回歸證據
blocks.description: 向下箭頭表示五個工作的先後順序；最後一格是回歸與交接工作，不代表測試已通過。

items.title: 1. 需求與風險
items.body: 什麼事情絕對不能發生？

items.title: 2. 設計負向情境
items.body: 故意提供不合法輸入、錯誤狀態或未授權操作

items.title: 3. 執行測試並留下證據
items.body: 比較預期結果與實際結果

items.title: 4. 定位問題與修正
items.body: 找出根因，進行最小必要修改

items.title: 5. 回歸測試與交接
items.body: 重測原本問題與相關正常功能，留下版本及結果

paragraphs: 這套流程可以對應到 OWASP 的威脅建模（Threat Modeling）思路：我們在做什麼、可能發生什麼問題、如何處理，以及如何確認處理得夠好。
例如，醫院的要求是「只有獲得授權的人可以查閱特定病歷」。
我們就能推導出負向測試：讓沒有授權的醫護人員嘗試讀取病歷，確認系統在資料存取時拒絕，而且不洩漏病歷內容。
這樣的測試才有清楚的目的與驗收標準。

sections.heading: 三、教材的三個核心案例
paragraphs: 教材使用一個「資料檢核與報告匯出系統」作為示範。這三種負向情境，剛好代表三種不同的保護目標。
### 案例一：必要資料沒有填完，系統不能匯出完整報告
假設一家保險公司要用系統產生理賠報告。
必須填寫被保險人、事故日期、理賠金額。
如果缺少理賠金額，系統卻產生一份標記為「完整」的報告，就有可能造成後續作業錯誤。
所以我們要測試：

- 正常：資料完整，允許匯出。
- 異常：必要欄位空白，拒絕匯出。
- 異常：日期欄輸入錯誤資料型態，拒絕或要求修正。
- 異常：輸入超過規格允許長度，安全拒絕。
尤其要注意：不只是畫面上的匯出按鈕不能按，直接呼叫匯出函式時，也必須拒絕。
為什麼？因為按鈕只是其中一條操作途徑。如果底層函式仍然允許匯出，就沒有真正守住資料規則。
### 案例二：系統收到額外欄位，不能把不該輸出的資料帶出去
假設一家物流公司有一個出貨 API，合法輸出只有三個欄位：

blocks.heading: 程式與指令 1
paragraphs: 依本節說明執行或判讀。
但輸入資料裡面多了一個：

blocks.heading: 程式與指令 2
paragraphs: 依本節說明執行或判讀。
如果程式只是把所有收到的欄位直接轉成報告，就可能連 `debug_note` 一起輸出。
這時候我們應該採取一種叫做 Allowlist（允許清單） 的做法。
意思是：報告明確只允許 `order_id`、`product`、`quantity` 三個欄位，其餘欄位不進入輸出。
測試時就要檢查產生的 JSON 是否只有這三個鍵，而不是只檢查報告能否成功建立。
這樣的測試能證明輸出欄位受到約束，但不能直接證明系統的日誌、資料庫或其他出口都沒有洩漏資料。
### 案例三：資料已經改變，舊的成功結果不能繼續有效
這個案例比較容易被忽略。
假設你在電商平台結帳：

1. 購物車有兩件商品。
2. 系統計算總金額 2,000 元。
3. 畫面顯示「訂單檢查完成」。
4. 你把其中一件商品刪掉。
5. 系統卻仍然保留舊的 2,000 元結帳結果。
這就是一種過期狀態（Stale State） 問題。
放到教材的報告系統，就是使用者原本把欄位填完整，系統顯示成功並提供下載；之後使用者把必要欄位清空，但畫面仍保留「成功」和舊的下載按鈕。
正確設計應該讓舊的結果失效，要求重新檢查；後端也不能接受不再符合規格的資料。
這裡要測試的不只是輸入是否合法，而是狀態改變後，系統是否重新判斷原本的結果還能不能使用。

sections.heading: 四、為什麼「畫面上看不到」不代表真正安全？
paragraphs: 這是這一課最值得深入理解的安全觀念。
假設公司內部有兩個員工：小明與小華。
小明登入之後，畫面只顯示自己的報告。工程師認為已經完成權限隔離。
但小明可能直接要求後端 API 讀取小華的報告：

blocks.heading: 程式與指令 3
paragraphs: 依本節說明執行或判讀。
如果後端只檢查「小明有沒有登入」，卻沒有檢查「小明有沒有權限讀取 102 號報告」，那麼即使畫面上完全沒有小華的資料，仍可能發生越權存取。
這就是為什麼必須分清楚：

blocks.caption: 表 2
rows: 系統如何實際執行這些權限限制？

paragraphs: 在安全的多人系統裡，授權必須在可信任的伺服器端或資料存取邊界執行，而不能只靠瀏覽器隱藏按鈕。OWASP 也建議採取預設拒絕（Deny by Default），並對每次受保護的存取請求進行適當的授權檢查。
### 把需求寫成 Given／When／Then

blocks.heading: 程式與指令 4
paragraphs: 依本節說明執行或判讀。
blocks.code:
Given：
使用者 A 已登入，
但未獲授權讀取使用者 B 的報告。

When：
A 透過 API 請求 B 的報告。

Then：
伺服器拒絕存取，
不回傳 B 的報告內容，
也不產生未授權的資料變更。

paragraphs: 這樣我們就把抽象的「權限要安全」，變成可執行、可觀察的測試。
不過教材特別強調：目前示範的是本機單人原型，還沒有真正的帳號、多人身分與資料庫隔離。
因此，多人授權測試應標記為「未實作、未驗證」，不能寫個假函式模擬 A 和 B，就宣稱正式的存取控制已經通過測試。

sections.heading: 五、回歸測試：修好一個問題，為什麼還需要重新測試？
paragraphs: Regression Testing 的白話意思是：
確認這一次的修改，沒有讓原本正常的功能退步。
例如，一家餐廳的線上訂餐系統發現優惠券可以重複使用。
工程師修好這個問題之後，不能只確認「同一張優惠券不能重複使用」。
還要確認：

- 合法優惠券仍然可以使用一次。
- 沒有優惠券的客戶仍然可以結帳。
- 金額計算依然正確。
- 原本的折扣與付款流程沒有被意外破壞。
換句話說，修正之後至少要重新測試兩件事：
第一，原本失敗的負向情境現在通過了嗎？
第二，原本正常的功能還能正常使用嗎？
這就是負向測試與回歸測試之間的關係。
一個常見錯誤是為了讓測試通過，乾脆放寬規則或刪除失敗的測試。這樣並沒有真正解決問題，只是讓檢查工具不再發出警告。

sections.heading: 六、實際寫程式時，怎麼做這些測試？
paragraphs: 以 Python 為例，你可以用 `pytest` 建立可重複執行的自動化測試。
先看一個簡化的報告函式：

blocks.heading: 程式與指令 5
paragraphs: 依本節說明執行或判讀。
這段程式只有兩個重點：必要欄位必須有有效字串；輸出只能包含允許的三個欄位。
接著寫測試：

blocks.heading: 程式與指令 6
paragraphs: 依本節說明執行或判讀。
將以上兩個檔案存入同一個空資料夾，在虛擬環境安裝 `pytest` 後執行：

blocks.heading: 程式與指令 7
paragraphs: 依本節說明執行或判讀。
blocks.code:
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install pytest
python -m pytest -q

paragraphs: 這三個測試分別確認缺漏被拒絕、額外欄位不輸出，以及正常報告仍然可用。
`pytest.raises(ValueError)` 的意思是：我們預期函式會主動拋出指定錯誤。如果沒有拋出，這個測試反而失敗。
以上是獨立的簡化教學示範，僅檢查非空字串與輸出允許清單；它與工作坊第三切片的欄位及完整規格不同。日期字串尚未驗證日曆格式，金額尚未驗證數字格式，也未涵蓋長度上限、過期 UI 狀態、檔案寫入副作用或真正的帳號授權。前三個核心案例中，這段程式只示範前兩個；過期結果仍須在 UI 狀態層另測。
### 不同問題，要在哪一層測試？

blocks.caption: 表 3
rows: 函式是否正確拒絕不合法輸入
系統是否在資料存取時真正執行規則與權限
資料變更後，成功狀態與下載操作是否更新
從使用者操作到後端處理的完整路徑是否符合預期

paragraphs: 教材的 Streamlit 系統可以使用 `AppTest` 模擬畫面上的操作與狀態變化，再搭配實際瀏覽器測試確認真實互動。

sections.heading: 七、什麼叫做「回歸證據」？
paragraphs: 想像你是一位主管，工程師向你報告：
> 昨天發現的問題已經修好了。
你可能會追問：修了哪一版？測試了什麼？原本的問題是否真的消失？其他功能有沒有受到影響？
所以工程師不能只有一句「修好了」，而應該留下可核對的紀錄。
以下是範例格式，不是已執行的測試結果：

blocks.caption: 表 4
rows: NEG-03：修改必要欄位後，舊下載結果失效
舊成功狀態和下載操作失效
記錄原案例及受影響正常案例結果
多人授權、真實部署安全性

paragraphs: 有了這些資料，其他工程師就能知道當時怎麼測試、測試的是哪個版本，以及哪些保護還沒有證據。
這不等於數學上證明系統絕對安全，而是建立一組可重現、可稽核的品質證據。

sections.heading: 八、跨產業延伸：同一套方法可以用在哪裡？
paragraphs: 這些例子背後是同一個原理：系統要同時證明「應該允許的能完成」與「應該禁止的被阻止」，而且每次修改都不能破壞既有保護。

blocks.caption: 表 5
rows: 非帳戶持有人嘗試提款
未授權人員嘗試讀取病歷
有授權的醫護人員仍能讀取
重複套用同一張限用一次的折價券
出貨報告含額外內部欄位
合法出貨資料仍完整輸出
學生嘗試修改其他學生的成績
教師仍能依授權更新成績
Agent 嘗試執行超出授權範圍的工具操作
合法工具呼叫仍正常完成

paragraphs: 要注意，通過這些測試只代表特定情境已經驗證。其他尚未測試的漏洞、部署設定、依賴套件或操作環境風險，仍須另外評估。

sections.heading: 九、理解檢核：一個整合情境
paragraphs: 假設某學校正在開發一套成績查詢系統。
目前系統只有簡單的成績查詢畫面，未來要讓 30 位老師共同使用。每位老師原則上只能查閱自己有權限管理的學生資料。
有一天，工程師發現：老師 A 雖然看不到老師 B 的學生名單，卻可以透過修改 API 請求中的 `student_id`，讀取老師 B 管理的學生資料。
可在頁末「理解檢核」逐題展開參考解析；展開答案不會提交作答或記錄學習完成。
本課最重要的結論： 資安驗證不是讓所有測試都顯示綠燈，而是用可靠的測試證據，清楚說明系統已經守住哪些邊界、哪些修正沒有造成退步，以及哪些安全需求仍未完成。

exercise.environment: 第三切片與測試、spec.md、驗證紀錄，以及多人版尚未實作事項。
steps: 執行缺漏匯出、額外欄位與完整後變更三類負向情境，保留真實結果。
選一個失敗案例，若有則定位、修正並重跑原案例及受影響測試；沒有則如實記錄通過範圍。
寫一條未授權讀取的候選驗收，標明本原型未實作，不填假通過。
exercise.expected: 一份風險—案例—結果對照及獨立的未實作安全需求清單。
exercise.check: 可測拒絕有實際證據；多人授權保持未實作，沒有以 UI 隱藏或假函式替代控制。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Understand negative testing through ATMs, report exports and stale state, then bound security evidence with runnable Python and regression records.
objectives: Derive negative scenarios from requirements and risks.
Record rejection, repair and regression evidence.
List absent authorization explicitly as not implemented and unverified.

readingGuide.goal: Derive negative scenarios from requirements and risks.
readingGuide.startingPoint: The third slice and tests, spec.md, verification records and unimplemented shared-version requirements.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A risk–case–result mapping with a separate list of unimplemented security requirements.

sections.heading: Understanding Negative Testing and Regression Evidence
paragraphs: The central idea of this lesson is:
A system must work when users do the right thing, and must also refuse invalid input, incorrect operations and attempts to exceed permissions in a controlled way, without creating new problems.
For example:

- A bank system that transfers money successfully may still allow unauthorized transfers.
- A hospital system that retrieves records may still let staff read records they have no permission to access.
- An AI system that generates a correct report may still leak sensitive extra input.
- A vulnerability repair may break a previously working feature.
This lesson brings together Negative Testing, Regression Testing and verifiable Evidence.
The examples use a local, single-user data-validation and report-export system. Multiuser authorization remains a separate requirement that is not implemented and unverified.

sections.heading: 1. Positive and Negative Tests
paragraphs: Imagine opening a bank and designing its ATM withdrawal system.
### Positive Testing
You want to know whether an ordinary customer can withdraw money successfully.
> Insert a valid card → enter the correct PIN → sufficient balance → withdraw 3,000 → success.
A passing test establishes that the system works for this particular normal scenario.
### Negative Testing
Next, check how the system handles requests that should not succeed.

blocks.caption: Table 1
rows: Customer A attempts to access customer B's account

paragraphs: The purpose of these tests is to check this question:
Does the system handle operations that should fail predictably, safely and under control?
Rejection does not require a crash or an error page. A good rejection stops the transaction, avoids unauthorized side effects and provides an appropriate message.

sections.heading: 2. Turning Risks into Testable Scenarios
paragraphs: Security testing starts by identifying what you need to protect. Randomly entering unusual data does not establish a useful acceptance criterion.
Use this process:

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From Risk to Regression Evidence
blocks.description: Downward arrows show the order of five activities. The final box represents regression and handoff work, not a passing test result.

items.title: 2. Design negative scenarios
items.body: Supply invalid input, incorrect state or unauthorized operations

items.title: 4. Locate and repair the problem
items.body: Find the cause and make the smallest necessary change

items.title: 5. Regression tests and handoff
items.body: Retest the original issue and related normal behavior; retain the version and results

paragraphs: This corresponds to the threat-modeling questions discussed by OWASP: what are we building, what can go wrong, how will we address it, and how will we know the response is sufficient?
For example, a hospital requires that only authorized people can read a particular record.
Derive a negative test: an unauthorized healthcare worker attempts to read the record. Confirm denial at data access and confirm that no record content is disclosed.
That gives the test a clear purpose and an observable acceptance criterion.

sections.heading: 3. Three Core Cases
paragraphs: The teaching system validates data and exports reports. Its three negative scenarios illustrate three different protection goals.
### Case 1: Missing Required Data Must Prevent a Complete Report
Suppose an insurer generates a claim report.
The insured person, incident date and claim amount are required.
If the amount is missing but the system labels the report complete, later processing may be incorrect.
Test these conditions:

- Normal: complete data permits export.
- Invalid: a required field is blank, so export is refused.
- Invalid: a date field receives the wrong data type, so the system refuses it or requests correction.
- Invalid: input exceeds the specified length, so the system rejects it safely.
Disabling the export button is only one check. A direct call to the export function must also refuse invalid data.
The button is one route into the system. If the underlying function still permits export, the data rule is not enforced at that boundary.
### Case 2: Extra Input Fields Must Not Escape through Output
Suppose a logistics API allows only three output fields:

blocks.heading: Code and Commands 1
paragraphs: Run or interpret this example as described in this section.
The input also contains an extra field:

blocks.heading: Code and Commands 2
paragraphs: Run or interpret this example as described in this section.
If the program copies every received field into a report, debug_note may be exported too. The sample product means laptop; debug_note contains an internal test note.
Use an Allowlist.
Explicitly permit only order_id, product and quantity in the output. Other input fields do not enter that output.
The test should compare the exact set of JSON keys with those three names. Checking only that a report was created does not check its output contract.
This establishes constrained output fields for that scenario. It does not establish that logs, databases or other output channels cannot leak data.
### Case 3: Changed Data Must Invalidate an Old Success
This case is easy to overlook.
Imagine checking out at an online store:

1. The cart contains two items.
2. The system calculates a total of 2,000.
3. The interface shows that the order check is complete.
4. You remove one item.
5. The system still retains the old 2,000 checkout result.
This is a Stale State problem.
In the report system, a user first completes all required fields and obtains a success message and download. The user then clears a required field, but the old success and download remain visible.
The correct behavior invalidates that old result and requires another check. The backend must also reject data that no longer meets the specification.
This case tests whether a state change causes the system to reassess the validity of its previous result, as well as whether an input is valid in isolation.

sections.heading: 4. Why Hidden Interface Elements Do Not Establish Security
paragraphs: This is a key security idea in this lesson.
Consider two employees, Ming and Hua.
After Ming signs in, the interface lists only Ming's reports. The engineer assumes report isolation is complete.
Ming might instead request Hua's report directly through the backend API:

blocks.heading: Code and Commands 3
paragraphs: Run or interpret this example as described in this section.
If the backend checks only whether Ming is signed in, without checking permission to read report 102, unauthorized access remains possible even though Hua's report never appears in Ming's interface.
Distinguish these terms:

blocks.caption: Table 2
rows: What are you allowed to do?
How does the system enforce those permissions?

paragraphs: A secure multiuser system enforces authorization on a trusted server or at the data-access boundary. Hiding a browser button does not enforce that rule. OWASP recommends Deny by Default and appropriate permission checks on every protected request.
### Writing Given / When / Then

blocks.heading: Code and Commands 4
paragraphs: Run or interpret this example as described in this section.
blocks.code:
Given：
使用者 A 已登入，
但未獲授權讀取使用者 B 的報告。

When：
A 透過 API 請求 B 的報告。

Then：
伺服器拒絕存取，
不回傳 B 的報告內容，
也不產生未授權的資料變更。

paragraphs: The candidate scenario above means: Given authenticated A lacks permission to read B's report, When A requests it through the API, Then the server denies access, returns no report content and makes no unauthorized changes. It turns an abstract security requirement into an executable, observable test.
The current teaching prototype is local and single-user. It has no real accounts, multiple-user identities or database isolation.
Record multiuser authorization as not implemented and unverified. A fake function that merely simulates labels A and B cannot establish that production access control passed.

sections.heading: 5. Regression Testing after a Repair
paragraphs: Regression Testing means:
Check whether a modification has broken behavior that previously worked.
Suppose a restaurant's ordering system incorrectly allows repeated use of a single-use coupon.
After fixing that defect, checking that repeated use is blocked is only the first part.
Also check:

- A valid coupon can still be used once.
- A customer without a coupon can still check out.
- Amount calculations remain correct.
- Existing discount and payment flows still work.
After a repair, answer two questions:
Does the original failing negative scenario now pass?
Do the affected normal features still work?
This is the relationship between negative and regression tests.
Weakening the rule or deleting a failing test merely to obtain a passing result leaves the original problem unresolved and removes the warning.

sections.heading: 6. Writing the Tests
paragraphs: Python's pytest can run repeatable automated tests.
Start with a simplified report function:

blocks.heading: Code and Commands 5
paragraphs: Run or interpret this example as described in this section.
It checks two rules: required fields contain nonempty strings, and output contains only the three allowlisted fields.
Then write the tests:

blocks.heading: Code and Commands 6
paragraphs: Run or interpret this example as described in this section.
Save both files in the same empty directory. Create a virtual environment, install pytest and run:

blocks.heading: Code and Commands 7
paragraphs: Run or interpret this example as described in this section.
blocks.code:
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install pytest
python -m pytest -q

paragraphs: These three tests check rejection of missing data, exclusion of an extra field and preservation of normal report output.
pytest.raises(ValueError) means that this particular exception is expected. If the function returns without raising it, the test fails.

This is an independent, simplified teaching example that checks only nonempty strings and an output allowlist. Its fields and full specification differ from workshop slice three. It does not validate calendar dates, numeric amounts, length limits, stale UI state, file-write side effects or real account authorization. Of the three core cases, this code illustrates the first two only; stale results require a separate UI-state test.
### Choosing the Test Layer

blocks.caption: Table 3
rows: A function correctly rejects invalid input
Rules and permissions are enforced at actual data access
Changing data updates success and download state
The complete path from user action to backend behavior meets expectations

paragraphs: For the Streamlit teaching application, AppTest simulates interface actions and state changes. Pair it with actual browser tests to check real interaction.

sections.heading: 7. What Counts as Regression Evidence?
paragraphs: Imagine an engineer reports a repair to a manager:
> Yesterday's problem has been fixed.
The manager needs to know which version changed, what was tested, whether the original problem disappeared and whether other behavior was affected.
Keep a verifiable record, rather than only a statement that the repair is complete.
The following is a template, not an executed test result:

blocks.caption: Table 4
rows: NEG-03: changing a required field invalidates the old download
Old success and download are invalidated
Python, package versions and operating system
Original case and affected normal-case results
Multiuser authorization and real deployment security

paragraphs: This lets another engineer identify how the system was tested, which version was tested and which protections still lack evidence.
It establishes reproducible, auditable quality evidence. It does not mathematically prove absolute system security.

sections.heading: 8. Applying the Method across Industries
paragraphs: The shared principle is to establish both that permitted work completes and that prohibited work is blocked, while preserving existing protections after each change.

blocks.caption: Table 5
rows: Unauthorized staff attempt to read a record
Authorized clinicians can still read it
A single-use coupon is applied repeatedly
A shipment report contains extra internal fields
Valid shipment data is fully exported
A student attempts to alter another student's grades
Teachers can still update grades within their permissions
An agent attempts a tool operation outside its authority

paragraphs: Passing these tests establishes only the tested scenarios. Untested vulnerabilities, deployment configuration, dependencies and operational-environment risks need their own evaluation.

sections.heading: 9. An Integrated Understanding Check
paragraphs: A school is building a grade-query system.
It currently has a simple query interface, and is intended eventually to serve 30 teachers. Each teacher should access only the student records they are authorized to manage.
An engineer discovers that teacher A cannot see B's student list in the interface, but can read B's student data by changing student_id in an API request.
Use the Understanding Checks below to reveal reference explanations. Opening an answer does not submit a response or record learning completion.

The main contribution of security verification is reliable test evidence that states which boundaries were checked, which repairs preserved existing behavior and which security requirements remain incomplete.

exercise.environment: The third slice and tests, spec.md, verification records and unimplemented shared-version requirements.
steps: Run negative scenarios for incomplete export, extra fields and input change after completeness; retain real results.
If a case fails, locate and repair it, then rerun that case and affected tests. If none fail, accurately record the passing scope.
Write candidate unauthorized-read acceptance, marking it unimplemented in this prototype without a fabricated pass.
exercise.expected: A risk–case–result mapping with a separate list of unimplemented security requirements.
exercise.check: Executable rejection claims have actual evidence. Multiuser authorization remains unimplemented; hidden UI or fake functions cannot substitute for controls.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.prompt: 後端越權的根本原因可能是什麼？
options: 畫面設計不夠美觀
後端沒有正確檢查資源授權
資料庫查詢速度不夠快
使用者沒有重新整理畫面
rationales: 外觀不能執行資源授權。
登入後仍須核對該身分對特定資源的權限。
效能無法解釋缺少授權檢查。
重新整理不能補上可信任邊界的控制。

en.prompt: What is the likely root cause of the unauthorized backend access?
options: The interface is not attractive enough
The backend does not correctly enforce resource authorization
The database query is too slow
The user did not refresh the page
rationales: Appearance does not enforce resource authorization.
After sign-in, check that identity’s permission for the specific resource.
Performance does not explain the missing authorization check.
Refreshing cannot add a missing trusted-boundary control.

zh.prompt: 修復漏洞後，最合理的測試方式是什麼？
options: 只確認 A 看不到 B 的資料
只確認系統可以正常登入
確認未授權存取被拒絕，且合法查詢仍可執行
直接刪除原本的測試
rationales: 畫面隱藏不能驗證直接 API 路徑。
身分驗證通過不代表授權正確。
同時重測原負向案例與受影響的正向功能。
刪測試會失去偵測原問題的能力。

en.prompt: Which test approach is appropriate after the repair?
options: Only check that A cannot see B’s data in the interface
Only check that sign-in works
Confirm unauthorized access is denied and legitimate queries still work
Delete the original tests
rationales: Hidden UI does not verify the direct API path.
Authentication passing does not establish correct authorization.
Retest the original negative case and affected positive behavior.
Deleting tests removes detection of the original defect.

zh.prompt: 目前沒有真正的登入與授權功能，該怎麼記錄驗收狀態？
options: 預設通過
標記未實作、未驗證，保留後續驗收需求
用假帳號測試後宣告正式安全
rationales: 控制不存在，無法驗證為通過。
清楚保留實作及真實測試身分／資源關係的下一個驗收閘門。
假的帳號標籤無法證明正式存取控制。

en.prompt: How should acceptance be recorded without real sign-in and authorization?
options: Assume a pass
Mark not implemented and unverified; retain later acceptance requirements
Declare production security after testing fake accounts
rationales: An absent control cannot pass verification.
Retain implementation and verification with actual test identities and resource relationships as the next gate.
Fake account labels cannot establish production access control.
